source_data: 180 source cruise episodes across low/mid/high constant-speed regimes, with near-steady initial states for the high-speed regime; identical source data for all methods, no target teacher data.
physics: unchanged dual-joint v2 planar model; 0.5 s primitives/decisions, 0.0005 s integration
policy: parameter-shared decentralized actor; centralized critic; fixed task for every run
expert_inputs: 25 local tracking-error, velocity, joint, previous-action, identity and neighbor features; heading command, target velocity, threat and task code only enter gate
mlp_inputs: same 35 features as the complete MoE actor
normalization: fixed analytic scales, no running normalization statistics
routing: weighted probability mixture is primary for both training and execution; Single-expert routing is a separate diagnostic
adaptation: freeze expert tensors; train gate actor and a reset critic; report both parameter budgets
baselines: MLP frozen backbone plus residual adapter
expert_count_control: match total actor capacity as closely as discrete widths permit; separately report per-expert capacity and gate trainable count
task_success: unchanged environment summary including safety and failure penalties

formal_acceptance.safety: no observed increase; report uncertainty and counts
formal_acceptance.efficiency: Target actor+critic optimization time at least 20% lower than full MLP adaptation in an isolated paired benchmark, with noninferior task performance. Also report end-to-end wall time, interactions, optimizer bytes and inference separately. Do not imply overall speedup from optimizer-only speedup. Compare small adapters honestly.

statistics: paired training seeds and scenes; seed-level estimates plus paired bootstrap intervals; five source seeds minimum; no omission of failures or threshold nonattainment
episode_return: undiscounted sum of mean reward across three fish in a completed episode; include terminal failures; exclude incomplete tail fragments
plotting: raw episode returns plus fixed trailing 10-episode mean, cross-seed sample SD; primary sample efficiency uses team steps
stop_policy: iteration on development evidence only; no claim of success when gate-only transfer or comparative advantage is not supported
hypothesis: A cruise-only expert bank can be reused by adapting a small target gate; superiority over small MLP adapters is not assumed.
initialization: Source desired-speed quantiles (.95 regional responsibilities, .05/K smoothing); source-only teacher labels, with balanced low/mid/high constant-speed source cruises. Target gate output layer initialized to zero (uniform mixture); all other gate weights inherited.
ablation_required: v12 full tracking commands at experts
v13 no position feedback at experts
v14 position feedback but no heading/speed commands at experts
source_validation: Original nominal cruise evaluation unchanged; source training contains broader task-0 conditions.
baseline_addition: feedback_mlp with the same expert input restriction, to separate information-structure effects from mixture effects
rationale: v14 target gate training changes performance only slightly; source data was dominated by near-aligned intermittent cruising. Broaden source task capabilities before freezing, not target data access.
old_test_collision: 960000..960019 were already evaluated in the old joint-training study. No scenes from 960000..960039 will be treated as fresh final tests.
target_optimizer: Adam; critic reset to seed-matched initialization; critic trained for every method
temporal_branch: T1->T2 and T1->T3 independently; no T2 data in T3 initialization
source_reuse: One source expert bank and three separately stored gates (source, escape, speed). Source gate retained without modification.
extra_controls: feedback MLP with same expert input mask
source-only uniform gate before target learning
timing: Concurrent training wall times are resource-confounded. Cache frozen expert outputs once per PPO batch; identically cache frozen MLP backbone logits for adapters. Bitwise-equal probabilities and trainable gradients verified. Log rollout and optimizer times, then benchmark isolated actor+critic update and inference on the same batches in balanced randomized order.
final_update_policy: Independent final tests are opened only after all models, protocol, development selection and benchmark scripts are frozen.
checkpoint_rule: Identical validation rule for all methods: successes first, then fixed primary metric; warm-start update 0 is eligible. Report selected update explicitly, including selection of 0.
